note: Fishing water kinds (design/FISH_AND_FISHING_PLAN.md, plan B). Numbers for src/server/server_fish_water.gd. sea bands are metres of water over the sea floor. A river whose narrowest run of wet cells is no wider than brook_max_width_m and shallower than river_min_depth_m is a brook. A baked lake (or loose water) of no more than pond_max_cells joined wet cells is a pond.
